summary: Lolo National Forest cupola-trailer lookout in Missoula County, gone by 1968; a 2020 amateur-radio report describes a Missoula County communication site on Point 118, about 200 feet from the summit, and does not mention a lookout.

notes_for_editor: History is one line on firelookout.com (1967 cupola trailer, gone 1968), corroborated by the Montana index (Trailer Gone). Today's description comes from a 2020 amateur-radio activation report (SOTA summit W7M/LM-108; RF and antenna content) that covers access and a communication site, not any lookout. The report's summit is about 200 feet from the communication site; nothing in the report ties the lookout to either, so the story does not say they are the same place. The report's URL path carries 2025-10-01 but its title dates the activation to 6 October 2020. Access is recorded as restricted from the gate description only, and no visit facts are recorded. A full-page read on 2026-10-10 found no mention of a lookout. Story is about 99 words. Used 2 searches and about 4 page reads.
